links.outcome: Perceived reliability, empathy and willingness to follow advice by labelled source (AI, Human, Human + AI)
links.effect: Identical advice labelled AI or Human + AI was rated significantly less reliable and less empathetic than Human-labelled advice. Participants were also less willing to follow it (N = 2,280).
links.quote: “AI” and “Human + AI”-labelled advice was evaluated as significantly less reliable and less empathetic compared to “Human”-labelled advice.
